aiResearchSummary.text: Yodlee is researching systems for financial information enrichment for intelligent credit decision making, predicting recurrence from financial data, and multi-dimensional credit worthiness evaluation. Their work includes quantifying the primacy of financial relations, financial account authentication, synthesizing user transactional data for de-identifying sensitive information, context-based data-driven classification, investment transaction enrichment, financial-based recommendation engines, and mobile application-based account aggregation. These areas reflect a focus on advanced financial data processing and user-centric financial solutions.
